book.transdimension.cloud_bible.1:
☁ The Cloud Bible ☁

The words of the angels of the Cloud Realm, for anyone who climbs this high.
book.transdimension.cloud_bible.2:
In the beginning there was the sky, and the sky was soft.

And the clouds said: let there be blue, and pink, and white. And it was good.
book.transdimension.cloud_bible.3: Blessed are they who become who they are, for the sky has always known their name.
book.transdimension.cloud_bible.4:
Thou shalt not deadname.

Thou shalt share thy cloud candy.

Thou shalt pet the Cloudies, gently.
book.transdimension.cloud_bible.5: When thou fallest, fear not: the turtle upon the cloud shall fish thee out of the sky, in a white boat, on a golden lead.
book.transdimension.cloud_bible.6: Rest a while in the holy water, and be made whole. Leave the golden things for those who come after.
book.transdimension.cloud_bible.7:
Go now, and be valid.

Amen. ✦
dialogue.transdimension.kira.fairy: If you ever face her... make her pay. No. Sorry. Maddie never wanted anyone hurt, not even her. Just be careful out there. I can't lose anyone else.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.gifts: She left these with me: her Trans Wand and her Trans Wings. She made them for travellers, and she always said the next one to find the house should have them. It's what she'd want. Will you look after them?
dialogue.transdimension.kira.gifts_given: How are her wings treating you? Crouch to charge, jump to launch, tap jump to flap: she made me learn it by heart. Fly far for her. And come back sometimes and tell me where they took you.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.greeting: Oh... hi. Sorry, I wasn't expecting anyone. I'm Kira. This is Maddie's house. Was. I'm looking after it now.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.greeting_ag: Hey, you came back. It's nice, having someone around. The house is so quiet without her.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.later: That's okay. They'll be here when you're ready. She'd have said the same.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.maddie: Someone woke the Trans Fairy, and Maddie went through her door to warn them. She said she'd be home for dinner. She never came back. Nobody found anything of her. It's like she was just... erased.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.now: Keep the house. Water her flowers; they still come up in trans colours every morning, like she's still here. She wanted the Egg House to be a safe place for anyone who needs one. So I'll keep it that way. For her.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.okay: Not really. Some mornings I still make two cups of cocoa. Her pillow still smells like strawberries. I keep waiting for her to float in through the window and laugh at me for crying. ...Thanks for asking.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.option.acce: I'll look after them. I promise.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.thanks: Thank you. She'd be so happy to see them fly again. Come and visit, okay? I don't like being alone up here.
dialogue.transdimension.kira.who: I'm Kira. Maddie was my girlfriend. We met under the heart clouds; she talked about eggs for an hour and I fell for her before she'd even finished. She said my head was the perfect size for kissing.
dialogue.transdimension.maddie.gifts: Actually... yes! I made these for travelers like you. A Trans Wand: it shoots sparkly hearts at anything mean. And Trans Wings! Crouch to charge, jump to launch, then tap jump to flap. Promise you'll fly safe?
dialogue.transdimension.maddie.gifts_giv: I already gave you my wand and wings, silly! Crouch on the ground to charge, jump to launch, tap jump while gliding to flap, and crouch in the air to hover down gently.
dialogue.transdimension.maddie.greeting: Oh! A visitor! Hi hi, I'm Maddie! Welcome to the Egg House, way up here in the clouds. Watch your step, it's a long way down!
dialogue.transdimension.maddie.greeting_: Hey, it's you again! How are the wings treating you? Not too many crash landings, I hope!
dialogue.transdimension.maddie.option.gi: Do you have anything for me?
dialogue.transdimension.maddie.place: This is the Trans Realm! Pink skies, heart-shaped clouds and Silly Cats who lick you better. My house floats so I see the sunrise first. Down below, every village hides a little cat plush in one of its houses. Can you find all nine?
dialogue.transdimension.maddie.thanks: Yay! Come back and visit whenever you like. And remember: you are loved, just the way you are!
dialogue.transdimension.maddie.who: I'm Maddie! I live up here with my garden, a whole lot of pink and way too many eggs. I made this place so anyone who finds it has somewhere cozy to rest. You're valid, you know that? Just checking!

message.transdimension.kira.gifts: Maddie wanted everyone who finds her house to have these: her Trans Wand and her Trans Wings. Look after them for her, okay?
message.transdimension.kira.line_1: Hi! I'm Kira. I'm looking after Maddie's house now.
message.transdimension.kira.line_2: My head is a perfectly normal size. Everyone else's is just tiny.
message.transdimension.kira.line_3: Maddie talked about the Trans Fairy all the time. I hope you showed her what you're worth.
message.transdimension.kira.line_4: I water Maddie's flowers every morning. They still come up in trans colours.
message.transdimension.kira.line_5: Fly safe! And if you fall out of the sky, the turtle on the cloud will fish you out.
